text: Verified (lifecycle trace + the agent's audit): NMP has NO autonomous/async/timer path that clears the active account. The slot only goes None via an explicit host command: `Reset`, `RemoveAccount`, or `AddSigner(AppManagedLocalNsec)` of the currently-active pubkey (runtime.rs:212-214). So on device, Chirp is issuing one of these post-sign-in.
